skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles of economic development and be able to classify countries based on their level of development.
Describe the basic characteristics of developing countries and provide evidence for specific countries.
Calculate and list criteria for evaluating economic growth in three areas: economic growth, structural change in the economy, and social progress.
Analyze and evaluate the current state of economic development in Vietnam and other developing countries.
Select and process domestic and international data to support conclusions about specialized topics.
Develop self-study habits and research skills, learn to listen and accumulate knowledge.
Have awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility.
